🎬 Kinda Pregnant (2025)

Kinda Pregnant follows Lainy, a woman who has always dreamed of becoming a mother but finds herself feeling left behind when her best friend announces she’s pregnant. Frustrated with her own life and desperate to experience the attention that comes with expecting a baby, Lainy makes an impulsive decision to wear a fake pregnancy belly. What begins as a harmless lie quickly spirals into a series of hilarious misunderstandings, awkward encounters, and unexpected complications. Things become even more complicated when she meets the man of her dreams, forcing her to maintain a secret that could ruin her chance at genuine happiness. Starring Amy Schumer, the film combines outrageous comedy with heartfelt moments while exploring friendship, jealousy, relationships, self-acceptance, and the pressure of meeting life’s expectations.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Romance

⭐ IMDb: 4.9/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 37m • R

🎥 Director: Tyler Spindel

✍️ Writers: Julie Paiva & Amy Schumer

📺 Where to Watch: Netflix in the United States. Availability varies by region.

source_details.synopsis: Kinda Pregnant is a 2025 American comedy film directed by Tyler Spindel, written by Julie Paiva and Amy Schumer, and starring Schumer alongside Jillian Bell, Brianne Howey, and Will Forte. The plot tells the story of 40-year-old school teacher Lainy, who gets envious when her lifelong best friend and colleague Kate and another co-worker are both pregnant, leading her to steal a fake pregnancy belly to pretend to be pregnant. The film was released on February 5, 2025 by Netflix. Kinda Pregnant was the most-watched title on Netflix during the week of February 3–9, hitting 25.1 million views in its first five days of streaming.
